title: Igrot Kodesh - Letter No. 208
response_propositions: The letter records sending printed material and discourses to Shanghai while noting that locally printed examples had rarely been sent back for review.
It reports that the Previous Rebbe was reviewing listeners' notes and directed that talks from two commemorative dates be published together.
It presses community members and students to record memories of the preceding period, criticizing the very limited response to repeated requests.
proposition_source_locator: publisher translation, lines 277-287: sections a-g on Shanghai shipments, editorial review, publication and memoirs
